import re

def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # First, replace all non-alphanumeric sequences with underscores (to keep track of word boundaries)
    # Then handle spaces vs punctuation differently
    
    # Approach: Replace consecutive non-alphanumeric chars with a single dash
    # except for regular letters/digits which should stay
    # But punctuation should be removed entirely
    
    # Step 1: Replace all sequences of non-alphanumerics with underscores
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '_', text)
    print(f'After replace non-alphanum with _: {repr(text)}')
    
    # Step 2: Remove standalone underscores (punctuation that was adjacent to letters)
    text = re.sub(r'_+', '', text)
    print(f'After removing standalone _: {repr(text)}')
    
    return text

    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    print(f'After collapsing dashes: {repr(text)}')

    return text.strip('-')
